dataPrivacy.title: How we handle your data
dataPrivacy.subtitle: Built for LFPDPPP compliance from day one. Here's exactly what we store, how long we keep it, and how you can take it back.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp messages
whatsapp.desc: Message content is never stored. Only the booking state is kept temporarily in memory and deleted when the conversation ends.

mobile.title: Phone numbers
mobile.desc: All mobile numbers are encrypted at rest using AES-256. Numbers are displayed masked by default — full numbers are only revealed on explicit request.

appointments.title: Appointment records
appointments.desc: Kept for 5 years from the appointment date, in line with standard medical record retention in Mexico. Permanently deleted after that.

consent.title: Consent records
consent.desc: Every consent grant and revocation is logged with a timestamp. Records are retained while the Client has an active relationship with any business on the platform.

deletion.title: Account deletion
deletion.desc: Clients can request account deletion at any time. Personal data is deleted immediately; appointment slots are anonymized for business reporting.

business.title: Business data
business.desc: On account closure, a 30-day grace period allows you to export your records. After that, all data is permanently deleted.
